活動内容: Our Rubber-Ball Baseball Club is a member of the Tokyo Six Universities Rubber-Ball Baseball Federation, and we compete in the spring and fall league tournaments with the goal of advancing to higher-level competitions. In recent years, we have achieved excellent results, including winning the Six Universities Fall League and reaching the quarterfinals of the East Japan Tournament. We are aware of our role as a leading team in the university rubber-ball baseball world and approach our daily practices with this mindset.Our members range from those with Koshien experience to those who have never played high school baseball, creating a diverse group. However, what we all have in common is a serious commitment to improving our skills, no matter how small the progress. We highly recommend this club to anyone who wants to aim for the national tournament in college or who is serious about baseball but finds a casual club insufficient!
活動日時・場所: Monday–Friday / 9:00 AM–11:00 AM or 1:00 PM / Shakujii Park, Ukima Park, etc.

名前: School of Science and Engineering Hardball Baseball Club
活動内容:
We are the only hardball baseball club at Waseda University and are part of the Science and Engineering Six Universities League. We practice 1–3 times a week. We train daily with the goal of winning the Six Universities League championship. Our managers include students from various universities, including Waseda, Nihon Women’s University, Tokyo Women’s University, Seisen Women’s University, Gakushuin Women’s University, Tokyo Kasei University, Showa Women’s University, and Kyoritsu Women’s University.We hold practices and games at various locations, primarily at ballparks in Tokyo and its suburbs, including Komazawa Park Baseball Stadium, Edogawa Stadium, Jingu Indoor Practice Facility, Asaka Municipal Stadium, Onoji Stadium, Kamiyuzuki Stadium, and Tachikawa Park Stadium.In addition to our March training camp in Miyazaki, May orientation camp, September summer camp, games at Tokyo Dome, and overseas trips, we also have a full schedule of non-baseball events, such as gym activities. Although our name includes “Science and Engineering,” we have many liberal arts students as well!
/
/
/
/If you’ve seen our Instagram and are interested, please come check out a practice! We’re recruiting even outside of orientation periods, so feel free to contact us via DM on social media!
活動日時・場所:
Weekdays (after classes) & Weekends
/
/
/
/Baseball fields in Tokyo or the Tokyo metropolitan area
/
/
/
/e.g., Komazawa Park Baseball Field, Edogawa Ward Baseball Stadium, Jingu Indoor Ballpark, Asaka Central Park Baseball Field

活動内容: We are the Edo Club, a rubber-ball baseball club celebrating our 50th anniversary this year! We practice twice a week, on Tuesdays and Fridays, with experienced and inexperienced players training together. As for club events, we hold a welcome camp in April and two-day, one-night tournament camps in June and November. During these camps, we form teams with members from various grades to play games, which greatly strengthens our team spirit.Furthermore, during our summer training camp in September, we not only practice baseball but also enjoy recreational activities like river play, a test of courage, and fireworks. We also hold a spring training camp in March. We actively participate in annual tournaments and work hard every day in practice with the goal of competing in the Pro-Sta and Kanto tournaments. In addition to baseball, we organize events that managers can enjoy as well, such as summer cruise parties, snowboarding camps, and class trips to Disney.
活動日時・場所: Every Tuesday and Friday / Between 3:00 PM and 7:00 PM / Kami-Igusa, Ukima, Tetsugakudo, etc.

活動内容: We all just love baseball! Our members range from fans of the 12 Japanese professional teams to fans of MLB and the Big Six universities. We not only go to games together, but we also have plenty of fun events, like playing amateur baseball at Yokohama Stadium and running a booth at the Waseda Festival! Plus, we play rubber-ball baseball twice a week at a Tokyo Metropolitan Park baseball field! We’re not exactly a powerhouse team, but our strength lies in everyone—beginners and women included—playing together in a friendly atmosphere. So if you’re looking to play casual rubber-ball baseball or want to make friends who support the same team, come join Select for the best college experience! Students from other universities and those participating in multiple clubs are also very welcome!
活動日時・場所: Every Tuesday & Friday / 5:00 PM – 9:00 PM / Tokyo Metropolitan Park Baseball Field (casual games), Irregular / Major baseball stadiums in the Kanto region (watching games)

名前: Waseda University Women’s Rubber-Ball Baseball Club WASEBI
活動内容:
Hello! We are the only women’s rubber-ball baseball club at Waseda! We practice about 3–4 days a week at fields in Tokyo! The best thing about WASEBI is that we take baseball seriously! We warmly welcome anyone who wants to stay active after entering university, as well as those looking to try something new!Most of our team members started playing baseball in college, and some have no prior sports experience at all! Even so, our coach and upperclassmen provide kind and thorough guidance, so even beginners can become regular players! We also actively welcome international students, so you can enjoy international exchange while playing baseball!!
/
/
/
/But let’s be real—as a college student, you’ll want to work part-time! And you’ll want to focus on your studies (?)! No problem!! We have plenty of players who balance practice with work, and you can work up to the maximum allowed under your parents’ tax bracket or even take a full course load! If you’re thinking, “This sounds like a stuffy baseball group that’s all about practice,” think again! WASEBI isn’t just a baseball team! On our days off, we go to a certain theme park, eat delicious sweets, and—before we know it—end up playing baseball anyway. We all get along great and have fun, regardless of whether we’re upperclassmen or underclassmen!!
/
/
/
/You don’t need a special reason to start playing baseball! If you’re reading this page, you’re probably already more interested in women’s baseball!! Come try it out, and you’ll definitely want to join!! We guarantee an absolutely wild and unforgettable youth!! We’re waiting for you!
活動日時・場所:
1–2 times on weekdays (determined based on members’ schedules), Saturdays, Sundays /
/
/Long breaks: Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays, Sundays
/
/Fields in Tokyo

名前: Waseda University School of Science and Engineering Rubber-Ball Baseball Club
活動内容: We operate under the nickname "Rikonan." All players are students from the School of Science and Engineering, and we practice twice a week on weekdays at a field in Tokyo. Recently, we have achieved good results in the Waseda League and other competitions, and we practice daily with the goal of playing at Jingu Stadium. We also hold training camps six times a year and incorporate various events to ensure a fun and friendly atmosphere throughout the year.Examples of our events include a freshman welcome BBQ, a summer cruise, and a Christmas party, among many others.In addition, we freely organize numerous activities such as class trips and training camps. We are recruiting both players and managers year-round, so please feel free to contact us!! Whether you want to play baseball, enjoy sports, cheer on the team with a big group, or find friends to share your college life with, why not join us? Let’s make the most of our college life together!!
活動日時・場所: Two days a week (irregular schedule) / 7:00 PM–9:00 PM (sometimes starting at 5:00 PM) / Johoku Park, Tetsugakudo, Kamitakada

活動内容: Waseda’s largest and strongest soccer club, made up entirely of Waseda students. We hold practices on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, aiming to help both players and managers grow and win titles.
活動日時・場所: Every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday / Koishikawa, Akabane, Shinsuna

名前: Waseda University School of Science and Engineering Soccer Club
活動内容: A soccer club commonly known as “Rikosa” or “Waseda Rikosa.” Practices are held twice a week, generally on Mondays and Thursdays, while weekends are reserved for matches, training camps, and away games. With over 50 years of history, it is one of the oldest soccer clubs at Waseda University. In the 2013 academic year, the club won the university-wide championship to determine the strongest soccer club at Waseda and placed third in the Magazine Cup, the largest tournament in the club scene.In the 2015 academic year, the club won the Second Division of the New Kanto League, which brings together strong teams from the Kanto region, and placed sixth in the Magazine Cup. Furthermore, in the 2016 academic year, the club advanced through the Kanto qualifiers to reach the national tournament, where it finished as runner-up.While the club was originally composed mainly of students from the School of Science and Engineering, in recent years there has been a significant increase in members from liberal arts faculties such as the School of Commerce, School of Political Science and Economics, School of Sport Sciences, and School of Humanities, as well as students from other faculties. As an inter-university club, the managers include both Waseda students and students from other universities. There is no admission fee, and club dues are collected on an irregular basis.
活動日時・場所: Every Monday, Thursday, and Saturday / Ochiai, Koishikawa, Maihama, Tanashi, etc.

名前: Faculty of Human Sciences Soccer Club: Human F.C.
活動内容: We belong to the "New Kanto Football League," the premier college soccer league. Our club consists of 120 members. Aiming to win the league title and become the best in Japan, we practice and play scrimmages 3–4 times a week around campus. We have a wide range of members, from those with experience in national tournaments to complete beginners. Our hallmarks are passionate, spirited play and an amazingly cheerful atmosphere.In the past, we have achieved consecutive victories in the Waseda University Intra-School Tournament and won the national championship. We warmly welcome not only those who want to play soccer, but also anyone seeking an environment filled with passion or simply looking to enjoy a fun campus life. Join us at one of the largest clubs on the Tokorozawa Campus and make the most of your student life. We actively host recruitment events, and new members are always welcome, even if you join mid-semester. Please feel free to contact us.
活動日時・場所: Every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday / Around Tokorozawa

活動内容:
Hello! We’re Liberdade, an officially recognized futsal club at Waseda University!
/
/
/
/We meet every Sunday in Kichijoji, with 55 male and 35 female members!
/
/Since many of the guys only have experience from middle school or earlier, we keep things laid-back!
/
/The women are players too, so we sometimes play futsal just among ourselves or join the men’s games! Of course, most of them are beginners! The club is full of kind and lively people, so it’s really fun—before you know it, you’ll find yourself coming back every week!
/
/
/
/We also organize activities beyond futsal, like summer and fall training camps, snowboarding trips, and various events, so you can be sure your time with us will be fulfilling in every way!!
/
/We’re super close within the club—we go out for meals or karaoke before practice, and we even go on trips split by grade level. We’re just really, really close!!/
/
/
/
/Liberdade has a really laid-back vibe in the best way possible. It feels like high school break time—we have as much fun as we can within reasonable limits!!
/
/
/
/If you want to play futsal but also want to join a club that organizes training camps and events!! If you’re someone who wants to have the absolute best time while being responsible and staying within reasonable limits!! Liberdade is definitely the best choice for you!!
/
/
/
/If you think it looks even a little bit fun or like it might be a good fit for you, please feel free to contact us!
/
/
/
/We look forward to welcoming you to join our friendly club!
活動日時・場所: Every Sunday, 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM, Futsal Park Kichijoji

活動内容: Our Soccer Viewing Club is a group that passionately cheers for our favorite soccer teams at stadiums across the country. Rather than organizing activities for the entire club, members who support the same team typically go to the stadium to watch matches whenever they like. However, we do hold regular social gatherings and futsal games as group activities. Additionally, as an annual event, we host a lecture in the fall featuring a guest from the soccer world.In recent years, we have invited former Japanese national team player Hisato Sato and announcer Tsuneyuki Shimoda. Since attending matches and events is not mandatory, this is a club where you can participate at your own pace. Whether you’re into the J.League, international soccer, or high school soccer, anyone who loves the sport is welcome. Let’s cheer together at the stadium!
活動日時・場所: Generally on weekends at stadiums across the country

活動内容:
We compete in Division 1 of the "New Kanto League," the top tier of college soccer. We are a college soccer club with over 150 members. Although we were founded in 2009 and have a relatively short history, we have won the national championship in the past and consistently achieve stable results, consistently placing among the top teams in recent years.
/
/
/
/The team is composed of Waseda University students, with a diverse range of players—from those with experience in national tournaments and youth teams to complete beginners.
/
/
/
/With the goal of becoming “Japan’s No. 1 soccer club,” we place equal emphasis on both the competitive aspect of soccer and having fun.
/
/
/
/Because we are a relatively new club, we have a free-spirited atmosphere without any formalities. We welcome new students who want to enjoy both soccer and college life to the fullest. If you’re interested, please feel free to contact us via social media.
活動日時・場所: 3 times a week (mainly Mon, Wed, Thu) / Times vary (mainly 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM) / Koishikawa, Ochiai, Nishitoyama, Yoyogi

活動内容:
The best thing about @Atmark is that anyone can enjoy playing soccer! We have members who started playing in college and others who have been playing since they were kids, all practicing together. There’s no attendance requirement—it’s a laid-back club where you can come whenever you want. Members get along great and often go out for meals or hang out after practice. We also have plenty of events, including four training camps a year and a summer camp. Plus, @Atmark fosters great relationships across all grades, so there’s no need to retire after your third year.It’s a club where you can enjoy yourself for all four years. We also hold events where alumni participate, and we maintain close ties with our former members.
/
/
/
/Let’s all play soccer together!!
活動日時・場所: Every Wednesday and Saturday / 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM / Kitano Sports Field, Sports Hall, Kōkū Park

活動内容: The appeal of the Soccer Club is that, despite our recent achievements, we operate on a non-regular roster system and get along great! The women—both managers and players—keep things lively and fun (lol).We have plenty of activities, including practice once or twice a week, tournaments, events, and social gatherings. Disney trips, Halloween parties, Christmas parties, snowboarding camps, and more... We’re all about pursuing the kind of fun that’s unique to college life! Lots of upperclassmen are waiting for you! Come create the best college memories with the Soccer Club!
活動日時・場所: Every Wednesday / 5:00 PM / Toshimaen

活動内容: The men’s team consists of students from Waseda University, while the women’s team is made up of students from various women’s universities. We practice on Thursdays at Nishitoyama Park in Takadanobaba and on Sundays at futsal courts in Tokyo. We are a fun-oriented team that prioritizes enjoying futsal. Since we are not a competitive team focused solely on winning matches, the atmosphere is relaxed, and beginners and women alike can play futsal casually and enjoy themselves.When it comes to tournaments, everyone gives it their all, but during practice and club tournaments, the focus is simply on having fun. We hold club tournaments and friendly matches against other Waseda University clubs. In addition to our regular Thursday and Sunday practices, we hold three training camps a year (May: Welcome Camp; Summer Vacation: Summer Camp; Spring Break: Spring Camp), as well as various recreational events such as sports days, walking rallies, road trips, and snowboarding.
活動日時・場所: Every Thursday and Sunday / 3:30 PM / Nishitoyama Park, Oji, Kinshicho

活動内容: We are PETIT ROYAL FC, one of the largest futsal clubs on the Tokorozawa Campus. Our rules are: 1. Beginners only (experienced female players are welcome), 2. No smoking during club activities, 3. No forced binge drinking during club activities.Twice a week, we play futsal at the Tokorozawa Campus Sports Hall, where everyone—regardless of gender or year—is a player. Since we’re exclusively for beginners, we welcome anyone who wants to try a new sport or just enjoy sports in a relaxed atmosphere. We also welcome those who don’t smoke or drink, as smoking and forced binge drinking are prohibited. In addition to our weekly futsal sessions, we hold three training camps a year, host summer and winter tournaments, and organize alumni gatherings and other events. We also participate in external tournaments regardless of gender or year.
活動日時・場所: Every Wednesday / 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM / Sundays 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM / Sports Hall

活動内容: Catsby works up a sweat playing futsal in the park twice a week. It’s an all-Waseda club, and all the women participate as players, not just managers. Many members are beginners, so rather than playing intensely or practicing hard to earn a spot on the starting lineup, this is a club where you can just drop by when you want to work up a sweat or see everyone, and have fun playing futsal! With about 20 members per year, the bonds between classmates and between upperclassmen and underclassmen are very strong. We participate in general public tournaments about once a month. Since we play against teams made up of working adults and sometimes even children, the matches remain friendly and relaxed from start to finish, even though they’re official tournaments! The fact that everyone gets along so well and looks out for one another is what makes Cats By so special!!
活動日時・場所: Every Wednesday & Saturday / 1:00 PM – 6:00 PM / Nishitoyama Park

活動内容: We have about 35 men and 35 women who play futsal once a week, every Friday in Kichijoji. In the first half of practice, everyone—men and women—plays together in mixed teams to have fun and get moving. In the second half, the men and women split up to play intense futsal matches.We also participate in tournaments several times a year; this past spring, our women’s team took second place in Waseda University’s internal tournament. Of course, we have plenty of events beyond futsal, including trips to Disney, camping, four annual training camps, summer cruises, and Christmas parties. The close-knit camaraderie among members is a major highlight of this club, and it’s sure to enrich your campus life. Fridays are all about Espiga.
活動日時・場所: Every Friday / 7:00 PM / Kichijoji

活動内容: Diente is a futsal club where everyone—from beginners to those who played soccer in high school, men, women, and international students alike—can have fun together. In particular, Diente is a futsal club with a large number of international students. We warmly welcome anyone who wants to interact with international students, have fun, learn a foreign language, or ask about traveling abroad. Also, while Diente has members ranging from advanced players to beginners every year, we all practice together with both fun and dedication. We may not be the strongest team, but we always create some drama at tournaments.The atmosphere is super laid-back, and we enjoy a relaxed time together, even when we go out for drinks. We have several training camps a year, plus plenty of other fun events! Diente’s homey atmosphere is the best at Waseda! Please come check out a practice session!
活動日時・場所: Every Tuesday, Thursday, and other days / 6:00 PM / Tabata Shinmachi Community Arena

活動内容: FC. TEMPESTA is a futsal club based primarily at the Tokorozawa Campus. Practices are co-ed, and we don’t have a manager! Whether you’re from Waseda or another university, a beginner or an experienced player, male or female—everyone enjoys futsal to the fullest.We participate in tournaments several times a year and have achieved great results in various places! While futsal is our main focus, we also have plenty of events! Summer training camps, Christmas parties, snowboarding trips, and more... Please feel free to join us! We look forward to welcoming you alongside our diverse and unique members!
活動日時・場所: Tuesdays and Fridays

活動内容: Founded in 2013, Tonsoku is an all-Waseda futsal club officially recognized by Waseda University. Despite being a relatively new club, it offers a training environment that rivals that of more established clubs, and its training camps and various events are exceptionally well-organized.We achieved official recognition from Waseda University in our first year and won the Waseda University In-School Tournament in our second year, demonstrating remarkable growth. Furthermore, this club fosters not only strong horizontal bonds among peers but also strong vertical bonds between seniors and juniors. One of our defining characteristics is that relationships are not one-sided from seniors to juniors; rather, there are many instances of juniors proactively reaching out to seniors. However, the most notable feature of this club is our “look.”We uphold the concept of “Start with the look.” Our attention to detail in uniform design, as well as the introduction of team jerseys and training gear not found in other futsal clubs, truly embody this philosophy. It’s often said that looking good means nothing if results don’t follow. But Tonsoku is different.In our very first year, we placed in the top ranks of various tournaments, winning the 2014 Waseda Futsal League and finishing in 3rd place in 2015. What’s even more surprising is that we operate without a strict starting lineup. It is precisely because every member approaches futsal with sincerity and dedicates themselves to training that we are able to achieve results as a team. We are looking for teammates who will join us in pursuing our goal of becoming “the best in Waseda in both name and reality.”
活動日時・場所: Every Tuesday and Thursday / 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM / Kinshicho, Toshimaen, Mejirodai

活動内容:
Under the mission "Take The Initiative From WASEDA," Waseda takes the lead to transform the norms of athletic clubs, university students, and futsal, and create the future.
/
/
/
/《Competitive Aspect》
/
/We are the only team at Waseda University authorized to participate in official matches. For many players who dedicated themselves to soccer in high school, we provide an environment where they can compete while officially representing the university’s name. We have no tryouts or athletic scholarship requirements, keeping our doors wide open to all.
/
/In terms of coaching, we boast an excellent staff led by a head coach and coaches with experience coaching in the F.League (Pescadora Machida).
/
/
/
/Affiliation: Tokyo Metropolitan University Futsal League
/
/Tournaments: All-Japan University Futsal Championship / All-Japan Futsal Championship
/
/
/
/《Operational Aspects》
/
/After joining the club, members are divided into five sections, allowing them to expand their scope of involvement in club operations.In our very first year, we secured approximately 3 million yen in sponsorship funds. From recruiting the head coach and coaching staff to securing sponsors and organizing national tournaments, everything is student-led. You’ll be able to engage in activities that you wouldn’t experience in a typical athletic club.
/
/
/
/Not only in competition but also in business operations, we offer meaningful activities that are unmatched by other organizations.

活動内容: We are a traditional rugby club founded in 1930. Thanks to our long history, we have a large alumni network and a strong organizational structure, which provides us with support in many areas. We also achieved the title of Japan’s top student club for two consecutive years in 2014 and 2015!This year, we are training hard every day with the goal of winning our third consecutive title. We warmly welcome both experienced players who want to take rugby seriously and beginners who want to try it for the first time! If you’d like to support the team as a manager, our upperclassmen will teach you everything you need to know, so don’t worry! All members of “G.W.” work together as one to energize the team, so we enjoy a fulfilling and fun student life both on and off the field. If you’re interested, please feel free to contact us!!
活動日時・場所: Every Wednesday, Saturday, and Sunday

活動内容: The Complex Rugby Team, competing in Division 1 of the Kanto Student Club Championship, is an officially recognized intercollegiate rugby club at Waseda University. We also have many players and managers from other universities. Please feel free to come watch our practices.We take pride in our strength, having won the "Championship & Japan’s No. 1 Student Club" title at the 2011 Kanto Student Club Championship and the "Championship" at the 2016 East Japan Student Club Sevens Tournament. We also host a variety of events, including BBQs, summer training camps, and spring trips. If you want to enjoy your college life, join us at Complex!

Every Wednesday / 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM / Kichijoji
Every Saturday & Sunday / 2:00 PM – 4:00 PM / Edogawa

活動内容: We train together with the Dentsu University Rugby Club. We have many beginners as well as experienced players, and we all enjoy playing rugby together. Last year, we won the Kanto 1st District Division 2 regional tournament with a perfect record.

Waseda Bacchus is an American football team affiliated with the Kanto Student Football Club Federation, which consists of athletic clubs, semi-athletic clubs, and interest groups from universities in the Kanto region.While Waseda University has over 3,000 student clubs, Waseda Bacchus is one of the few clubs officially recognized by the School of Science and Engineering. We have a clubroom in the Toyama Campus Student Union Building (Building 30), and our activities are open not only to students from the School of Science and Engineering but to students from all faculties at Waseda University (including managers from other universities).Even after graduation, alumni continue to maintain ties with Bacchus. 活動内容: Hello! We, the Waseda Rebels, are an officially recognized American football club for all Waseda University students! We practice four times a week (Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays, and Sundays). On weekdays, participation is optional, and on weekends, we all gather at the Tama River riverbank for our activities. Our team belongs to the Kanto Student Football Club Federation, and we train hard every day with the goal of winning the Kanto Championship held at the end of December.Since our founding in 1978, the Rebels have built a proud record of 12 league championships and 10 Kanto titles. While we are a team that prioritizes skill and is committed to winning, we also have many complete beginners on our roster. (In fact, over 70% of our players are beginners.) Our season kicks off in February. We begin spring training in preparation for the traditional Waseda-Keio game against the Keio Bisons, which takes place around late April.In June, we play exhibition games. In August, we have a summer training camp. Then, the tournaments begin in September. The regular season runs from there through November, and in December, we compete in the Kanto Championship, which is our ultimate goal. While this is our main schedule, we also have an off-season, and when we’re not practicing, we all go out and have fun together! If you’re interested in what we do, please check out our Instagram (@waseda_revels)! We are currently recruiting players, managers, and staff!!
活動日時・場所:
Every Tuesday & Thursday: Fields in Tokyo
/
/
/
/Every Saturday & Sunday: Tamagawa Maruko Bridge Field

活動内容: We are a basketball club at Waseda University’s Tokorozawa Campus!! Established in 2013, we’re a fresh, new club with a friendly, homey atmosphere where we take basketball seriously while having fun. We compete in tournaments several times a year, and players of all skill levels—from beginners to experienced players—train together. You might be worried, thinking, “I’m a beginner—will I be okay?” but don’t worry. We have plenty of members who are happy to teach you, and eventually, you’ll be able to play in lots of games! We also have plenty of events beyond just basketball! In addition to practice, we go out together, which helps you bond with members—you’re sure to make lifelong friends!!!!
活動日時・場所: Every Tuesday & Friday / 5:00 PM / Tokorozawa City Gymnasium; Every Thursday / 4:30 PM / Sports Hall

活動内容: We are a club based in Tokorozawa that enjoys playing basketball, aiming to win the Waseda League every March and August!

活動内容:
Enjoy everything to the fullest! The biggest and strongest circle! Beginners are very welcome!

We, the Waseda University Tennis Club (commonly known as WTC or Soutei) are the biggest, strongest and simply the best club!

There are three main attractions! Firstly, everyone here is unique. We are all Waseda students and come from all faculties! Not to mention, as we accept enrollment all year round, international students and September-entry students are always welcomed!

Moving on to tennis, we have members of various levels, of course beginners! Last year, we won the cup runner-up and the Kanto club women's team runner-up! We also must not forget its desirable practice environment, having practice from 5 to 6 days a week from 9:00 to 16:30 on weekdays!

WTC is not only known for its tennis but also for its fun events! We often host BBQ, bowling, and sports day events. Not only those, you can also become a ball person for professional games! WTC is the best circle for making friends and memories!

If you have interests even a little bit, please come and try out!
活動日時・場所: Monday-Friday/practice9:00-16:30/航空公園、Saturday/practice17:00-21:00/木場公園や城北中央公園

名前: School of Science and Engineering Hardcourt Tennis Club
活動内容: Most of us in the School of Science and Engineering Hard Tennis Club (commonly known as "Ricote") are students from the School of Science and Engineering, so we get along really well! We practice every weekday, and we even have night sessions—which is great for students in our school! We placed 3rd in the 2019 Waseda Cup, and we welcome both advanced players and beginners! While we give our all to tennis, we also give our all to having fun—that’s what Ricote is all about! We have plenty of events and activities (snowboarding, fireworks, trips to the beach, etc.)!
活動日時・場所: Weekdays: Daytime / Night sessions: Once a week

活動内容: Waseda Young is one of the twelve officially recognized clubs at Waseda University! Since we’re an officially recognized club, our operations are well-organized and reliable. Our members consist of men from Waseda University and women from Waseda, Japan Women’s, and Gakushuin Women’s Universities. However, everyone gets along great regardless of gender, university, or year! About half of our members are beginners, and the other half are experienced players.We offer special practice sessions for beginners, so even those new to the sport can enjoy tennis with confidence. We also have a strong track record, including a top-8 finish in the Kanto tournament, so experienced players looking to play seriously are more than welcome. We practice five days a week on weekdays, so you can attend during your free time between classes and enjoy lively, energetic sessions with everyone! Additionally, Waseda Young competes annually in team tournaments such as the CUP, Kanto, and Assé, and everyone works hard every day to prepare for them!Team tournaments, where we come together as one, are sure to be an emotional experience. In addition to tennis, we hold seasonal events every month—such as Christmas parties where we go to the beach or river, play mixed doubles in costumes, and then party at a stylish sky lounge—so you can bond with everyone outside of tennis as well. Our lively drinking parties are also a must-see.No chugging, no pressure, and we even have a water table, so everyone can enjoy themselves safely and comfortably! Come join us at Young and let’s make the most of your college life together!! You won’t regret joining us!!
活動日時・場所: Weekdays / Courts near Takadanobaba

活動内容:
Hello! We’re Young!
/
//Young is an all-Waseda soft tennis club! We practice about 2–3 times a week, mainly at Johoku Central Park and Ukima Park, which are about a 30-minute walk from Waseda University’s main campus.Practices always have a friendly, welcoming atmosphere, and we make sure everyone gets equal opportunities to practice and play matches. This allows us to practice with a variety of people, form partnerships, build friendships, and get inspired. Since we practice on weekdays from 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM, you can easily join even after classes!
/
/
/
/The Young team belongs to the Gakudoren Federation and competes in intercollegiate tournaments against other universities in the spring and fall (Spring Gakudoren and Fall Gakudoren). Players who advance through these tournaments qualify for the Kanto Open and Kanto Indoor tournaments, and in August, they compete in the biggest event of the year: the All-Japan Student Open (commonly known as "Zennichi"). Last year, we won both the men’s and women’s team and individual titles at Gakudoren, and at Zennichi, we took second place in the men’s team competition and won the men’s individual title!Each tournament consists of men’s and women’s team and individual events, and anyone can participate regardless of skill level!
/
/
/
/We also host plenty of fun events about once a month! We organize a variety of activities, including BBQs, short trips, sports tournaments, and training camps. You’re sure to meet amazing friends you can only find at Young and enjoy a fulfilling life at Waseda! Young is a club that can be your “home away from home”! If you’re even slightly interested, feel free to contact us via social media or other channels!
活動日時・場所: 2–3 days a week at Johoku Central Park and Ukima Park

活動内容:
The Soft Tennis Club, founded in 1962, is Waseda’s oldest soft tennis club.
/
/
/
/In the spring and fall, we participate in intercollegiate matches among the Six Universities (Waseda, Tokyo University, Meiji, Keio, Hosei, and Rikkyo) (commonly known as the “Six-University Series”), the “Kanto Open” (open to players who advanced from the spring Six-University Series and those with three years or less of experience),
/
/
/
/In the summer, we participate in the “East-West Showdown,” a competition between the Six Universities and the Four Kansai Universities (Kansai, Kwansei Gakuin, Doshisha, and Ritsumeikan); the “All-Japan Student Open,” which features clubs from across the country and athletic associations at the 5th division level or below;
/
/
/
/and at the end of the year, the “Waseda-Kwansei Gakuin Match” against Kwansei Gakuin University. We compete in numerous tournaments throughout the year.
/
/
/
/Even during the winter off-season, there are indoor tournaments we can enter if we win our way through the fall "Rokuren" tournament.
/
/
/
/Whether in singles or doubles, there are plenty of opportunities to play matches regardless of skill level!
/
/
/
/We hold practice sessions 4 to 6 times a week, so you can participate on days when you don’t have classes and get plenty of balls in. We have two training camps a year: one in the summer at Lake Yamanaka in Yamanashi Prefecture and one in the spring at Shirako in Chiba Prefecture.
/
/
/
/Skill levels range from beginners to those with experience in the National High School Championships, and even those who lack confidence in their skills are sure to improve.
/
/
/
/As for activities outside of tennis, we go on hot spring trips and ski trips during the off-season, and club members often go out together for fun.
活動日時・場所: 4–6 days a week (Koukuu Park / Johoku Central Park)

活動内容: We are a Waseda University-recognized club celebrating our 61st anniversary this year and are members of the 12 Major University League! We are an all-Waseda club with members from all campuses, both men and women! We practice 6 days a week from Monday to Saturday, plus one night practice per week! We have many members with experience in the National High School Championships and Inter-High, so you can enjoy high-level training!Additionally, about half of our members are beginners who started playing tennis in college, so you can learn the basics from seniors with coaching experience! There are no membership restrictions or deadlines! We compete in three team tournaments a year and have a strong track record! We placed 4th in the Waseda Cup from 2016 to 2019 and in 2023! We placed 3rd in the 2023 ASSE Team Tournament! In addition to tennis, we organize year-round events like beach trips, summer cruise parties, and New Year’s celebrations, so you can enjoy a fulfilling college life all year long! We warmly welcome anyone who wants to take tennis seriously, anyone who wants to learn to love tennis, and anyone who wants to give their all to something! Come join us on the green and have the best college experience possible!!
活動日時・場所: Every Monday through Saturday / 1:00 PM / Toei Tennis Courts

活動内容:
Hello! We’re the Johoku Tennis Club!
/
/
/
/We hold 4-hour practice sessions every weekday. It’s a drop-in format where you can join whenever you want based on your classes and schedule, and you’re free to leave whenever you like.
/
/
/
/While we have advanced players—including National High School Championships participants, National Invitational Tournament participants, and prefectural top-4 finishers—we also have plenty of beginners who started playing in college!
/
/
/
/We compete in team tournaments three times a year and are working hard to advance to the top four in the Waseda University Cup ^ ^
/
/
/
/We’re a medium-sized club with a 1:1 male-to-female ratio and about 30 members per grade!
/
/
/
/It’s not just about tennis—we have tons of monthly events too! Christmas parties, trips to Disney, Odaiba, summer cruise parties, and more...
/
/
/
/In short, joining Johoku is definitely the right choice!
/
/
/
/If you have any questions, feel free to ask us anything via DM on Twitter or Instagram!
活動日時・場所: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM

活動内容: We at the Inatomo Tennis Club are a welcoming, family-like club that warmly welcomes both experienced players and beginners!! We practice five days a week, and since participation is open to everyone, you can play tennis whenever you have free time or just feel like getting some exercise! For beginners, we start with “Beginner Practice,” where skilled experienced players use one court to teach you carefully! As a result, we’ve even produced winners in tournaments exclusively for beginners!! Our experienced members are all top-level players, including former All-Japan High School Champions and Saitama Prefecture Top 4 finishers! So, even if you’re an experienced player, you’ll find an environment where you can fully enjoy tennis! Plus, Inayuu offers a full calendar of events to enjoy all year round—not just tennis! Because we enjoy both tennis and these events, everyone in the club gets along great, and this close-knit, welcoming atmosphere is Inayuu’s biggest appeal!!
活動日時・場所: Every Monday–Friday / 9:00 AM–5:00 PM / Tennis courts near Waseda

活動内容: The Orange Tennis Club centers on tennis and engages in a variety of activities. It is a club that helps make university life more meaningful and allows members to grow significantly through their experiences. Orange is an officially recognized federation at Waseda University and one of the "12 Major Clubs," boasting a long history spanning 45 years. Our motto is to give our all and enjoy ourselves to the fullest, whether it’s tennis, events, or just having fun. You won’t experience true enjoyment if you just go through the motions in the club.We tackle everything with passion and enthusiasm. The main tennis event is the Waseda Cup, a team competition where the 12 Major Clubs compete for rankings. Both players and supporters unite as one toward victory. Our daily practice sessions are also fun and fulfilling. Another key attraction of Orange is our strong focus on tennis beginners. Beginners can experience the joy of rapid improvement if they receive proper instruction.We have dedicated coaches assigned to beginners who teach them everything from the ground up. Furthermore, Orange fosters an atmosphere where beginners and advanced players practice together without distinction, creating strong bonds regardless of skill level. Of course, our experienced players are highly motivated and aim for ambitious goals, such as winning the All-Waseda Tournament and team competitions.Our events are packed with fun activities throughout the year, including training camps, beach trips, fireworks parties, and Christmas parties. We put a lot of effort into each event, and everyone has a great time. With Orange, you’re sure to have a college life that’s not only fun but also fulfilling.
活動日時・場所: Every Monday and Friday / 9:00 AM – 11:00 AM / Toei Tennis Courts; Tuesday and Wednesday / 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM / Toei Tennis Courts

活動内容: The Australian Tennis Club is a Waseda University-recognized club with a history spanning over 40 years. We focus on the Waseda Cup, held every May, and train diligently every day. While we have experienced players, many members are beginners who started playing tennis in college; however, our coaches provide careful instruction, so you can improve quickly.Practices are held twice a week on irregular days, making it easy for all members to participate. During regular practice sessions, experienced players and beginners mix together for basic drills, while members competing in tournaments engage in high-level training during dedicated practice sessions. We also host plenty of events outside of tennis, such as barbecues and snowboarding! As a medium-sized club, we have a close-knit, family-like atmosphere where everyone gets along well, regardless of seniority!!
活動日時・場所: Twice a week on irregular days

活動内容: The F.S.S. Tennis Club is a historic, Waseda University-recognized tennis club now in its 47th year. We aim to improve the tennis skills of all our members through twice-weekly practices on Tuesdays and Thursdays, primarily held at the Japan Women’s University tennis courts and the Toei courts in Ukima-Funado.F.S.S. warmly welcomes beginners! Many of our members started playing tennis in college, and with guidance from experienced players, you can develop your skills to the point where you can compete in real matches. Since we do not belong to any on-campus league, there are no grueling training schedules—our appeal lies in being able to play tennis in a fun and relaxed atmosphere. You can showcase the results of your daily practice through tournaments held during our training camps, which take place up to five times a year.F.S.S. also hosts plenty of events to help members bond! With monthly gatherings—including fireworks festivals, Halloween parties, and Christmas parties—you can fully enjoy university life through seasonal events! Above all, our tennis club is characterized by the close-knit relationships among members and a warm, welcoming atmosphere! Whether you’re a tennis beginner or an experienced player, please come visit F.S.S. sometime!
活動日時・場所: Every Tuesday & Thursday / 5:00 PM / Japan Women's University Tennis Courts & Ukima-Funado Toei Courts

活動内容:
We are a historic, Waseda-approved tennis club founded in 1975! With a 1:1 male-to-female ratio and an equal number of experienced players and beginners, this is a club where anyone can enjoy tennis! With a total membership of just 40 people, it’s a small, welcoming group where everyone gets along quickly! Plus, as we belong to the historic “12 Major Clubs” organization, you can rest assured and enjoy the best club life possible!
We hold regular practice twice a week at tennis courts in Tokyo! Since the days vary, you can attend practice on whichever day suits you best! We offer beginner-friendly sessions, so even those starting tennis in college can improve quickly! Of course, experienced players can also get in some intense practice with their peers!
We also hold monthly events and four training camps a year, so you can enjoy activities beyond just tennis! Thanks to the cozy, family-like atmosphere that comes with being a small group and our packed event schedule, everyone—regardless of gender or seniority—can get along great! Let’s make the most of your college life at Crest!!
活動日時・場所: Days vary / 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM / Tennis courts in Tokyo such as Ukima Park, Kiba Park, and Sarue Onshi Park

活動内容:
We are a university-recognized tennis club celebrating our 45th anniversary this year! With a 1:1 male-to-female ratio and about 25 members per grade, our club has a total membership of around 100! Not only do we get along well with our peers, but we also have strong bonds with both upperclassmen and underclassmen. This close-knit, family-like atmosphere is Forty-Love’s greatest feature (^^)
/
/
/
/Since all the men are from Waseda University and the women are from Waseda, Japan Women’s, and Tokyo Women’s, it’s a great perk that you can build connections not only with people from your own university but also with students from other universities! We practice twice a week on Mondays and Thursdays, with sessions in the morning and afternoon, so you can play tennis during your free periods between classes! We also hold night practice and beginner sessions, so even if your practice days are filled with classes, you can still get in a game!Plus, since people with the same free days often play together, you’ll never lack opportunities to play! With a 1:1 ratio of experienced players to beginners, even those starting tennis in college can feel at ease! We also have members with tennis coaching experience, so even experienced players can push each other to improve! Beginners will get better and better too (^-^)
/
/
/
/We use a variety of courts in areas like Sarue, Johoku, Akatsuka, Shinozaki, Toneri, Fuchu, Kiba, and Omiya, making it easy to join! We belong to the "12 Universities" league, which has a long history and a solid organization, so you can enjoy club life with peace of mind (^O^)
/
/
/
/Last year, we placed 5th in the Waseda Cup!!
活動日時・場所: Every Monday & Thursday / 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (drop-in) / Sarue, Johoku, Akatsuka, Shinozaki, Toneri, Fuchu, Kiba, Omiya, etc. / Waseda University Building 15 Lounge

活動内容: The Galaxy Tennis Club is a medium-sized tennis club with about 25 members per year and a 1:1 male-to-female ratio. All members are Waseda students, so you’ll make lots of friends from various departments. More than half of us are tennis beginners, but our upperclassmen provide patient instruction, so beginners can feel at ease! Of course, experienced players are also very welcome.Let’s have fun and improve our skills together! Seniors and juniors get along very well; we go out together, and during lunch breaks or free periods, we gather in the lounge to hang out. At Galaxy, we hold various events every month, such as sports activities, fireworks festivals, and the Waseda Festival, so you’ll be able to create plenty of memories with everyone! For us, Galaxy is a comfortable place and an indispensable part of our college life. Why not join us at Galaxy to spend the best college life with the best friends??
活動日時・場所: Every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday / 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM / Kiba Park Courts

活動内容: Are you a freshman looking to try something new? Do you want to play tennis? Do you want to have fun with others? Do you want to meet great friends? Why not make those dreams come true with the Home Tennis Club? We are a small, all-Waseda club—a rarity among the many tennis clubs on campus! This offers unique advantages. Because we’re a small group, you get more court time and can hit plenty of balls.As a member of the New Waseda University Tennis Federation Division 3, Home Tennis Club participates in exchange matches and team competitions with other clubs, which serves as a major source of motivation for our players. Even if you’re new to tennis, you’ll be taught from the ground up, and courts are assigned by skill level, so you can feel at ease! While we focus on tennis, we also have plenty of events! You can enjoy a variety of events throughout the year, such as a walking rally where you explore Tokyo’s famous sights while completing challenges, trips to large parks to play soccer or “Red Light, Green Light,” and watching the Waseda-Keio rivalry match! And now for the part everyone is most curious about: the social gatherings. At Home, our motto is “relaxed drinking.” There’s absolutely no pressure to chug drinks—it’s a laid-back atmosphere where everyone chats and laughs together! Finally, with a small class size of about 15 students per year, you’ll build deep connections not only with your peers but also with upperclassmen and underclassmen. Why not spend four amazing years at Home and make lifelong friends?
活動日時・場所: Two days per week (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) / 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM / Tetsugakudo Park

活動内容: We, t;M, are a tennis club active on the Tokorozawa Campus. We use the Tokorozawa Campus tennis courts to play tennis three times a week in a relaxed and laid-back atmosphere. Our membership fee is just 1,000 yen—an unbeatable price you won’t find at other tennis clubs! We also welcome beginners, and many new members join us every year. Our upperclassmen provide patient instruction, so you’ll improve quickly. We host plenty of events, including three training camps a year and a Christmas party—there’s no shortage of fun activities. Come join t;M and make the most of your college life!
活動日時・場所: Every Monday, Thursday, and Friday / 1:00 PM – 7:30 PM / Tokorozawa Campus Tennis Courts

活動内容: Hello! We are the Truth Tennis Club, an official Waseda University-recognized, all-Waseda tennis club with a friendly, family-like atmosphere! We are a medium-sized club with about 20 members per grade and a 1:1 male-to-female ratio! This club is perfect for anyone who wants to play tennis but finds Waseda’s tennis clubs a bit intimidating…Both beginners and experienced players are very welcome! We practice three times a week at a tennis court about 15 minutes from campus! Even if you’re a beginner, our upperclassmen will teach you patiently, so you can feel at ease! About once every three months, we rent a large tennis court to hold internal tournaments! In addition to tennis, Truth offers plenty of fun events throughout the year, including three training camps, watching the Waseda-Keio match, Waseda Festival, and Christmas parties!And above all, the best thing about Truth is meeting amazing friends! You’re sure to make lifelong friends with the Truth crew! Let’s enjoy the best college life possible with these amazing friends!
活動日時・場所: Every Monday, Thursday, and Friday / 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM / Ikebukuro & Akabane

活動内容: Exclusively for science and engineering students! We’re a tennis club affiliated with the Shin-Soren (New Early League) where you can excel at both tennis and your studies! Guided by our motto—"No Drink, Money is important, We Love Tennis"—we engage in serious yet fun activities! We practice 2–3 times a week during evening sessions that don’t conflict with classes. We also set aside preparation time before exams, so even as a tennis club, we prioritize our studies!Of course, there are plenty of fun activities, including events like "Escape" and Christmas parties, regular friendly matches, and our super exciting summer training camp! The gender ratio is about 1:1, and we have members ranging from beginners to experienced players. If you’re thinking, “I want to play tennis in college, but I’m not sure if I can keep up with a tennis club…” then this is for you! Please come visit us at Laissez-Faire!! Let’s spend the best college life together! All of us in the club are looking forward to meeting you!
活動日時・場所: 2–3 times a week (Fridays are fixed), 2–3 times a week at locations like Johoku Park
Every Monday–Friday / 8:00 AM–10:00 AM, 1:00 PM–5:00 PM / Tennis courts near Waseda

名前: Waseda University School of Science and Engineering Volleyball Club
活動内容: The School of Science and Engineering Volleyball Club has long been affectionately known by the nickname "Rikobare." As an officially recognized club of the School of Science and Engineering, and since it is primarily composed of students from the School of Science and Engineering, practice days are scheduled for weekday evenings and Saturday afternoons to avoid overlapping with classes as much as possible. Members consist of players (men only) and managers (women only). While the club is primarily science-oriented, there are also members from the humanities, creating a friendly and harmonious atmosphere.We participate in many tournaments, centered around the biannual Club League (May, November) and the Science and Engineering League (June, December), and hold three training camps (August, November, March).I think this club is perfect for anyone who wants to play volleyball seriously without letting it interfere with their studies, and who also wants to enjoy training camps, social gatherings, and events (＾◇＾). If you’re wondering which club to join, want to start playing volleyball, or are busy with school but still want to play, please come check us out!! As a general rule, we only recruit new members during the orientation period (April and May)!
活動日時・場所: Every Monday and Thursday (Okubo Elementary School: 6:00 PM – 9:00 PM), Saturdays (Okubo Elementary School: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM)

活動内容: The Volleyball Club is an officially recognized volleyball club at Waseda University. We practice twice a week—every Tuesday and every other Thursday and Saturday—primarily at gyms in Tokyo, including Setagaya Ward, Itabashi Ward, and Kiyose City.The club is run by third-year students in leadership roles. With a loud and cheerful president, a vice president whose remarks are often hard to follow, a treasurer skilled at one-liners, and a carefree manager, these third-years—each with their own unique personalities—create a lively atmosphere at every practice. Aiming for the club league held twice a year, both beginners and experienced players enjoy volleyball while taking it seriously.Relationships between men and women, as well as between upperclassmen and underclassmen, are very close. On weekends, we often go on road trips, visit amusement parks, play beach volleyball, and go on all sorts of outings together. In addition to daily practices, we have plenty of events, including training camps, snowboarding trips, the Waseda-Keio match, and the Waseda-Kwansei Gakuin match.Since training camps and snowboarding trips involve overnight stays, all club members get to know each other very well! If you’re a new student thinking, “I want to start playing volleyball in college!” “I want to keep playing volleyball in college!” or “I want to make the best friends in college!”, please come join us for practice or our welcome camp!
活動日時・場所: Every Tuesday / 6:30 PM – 9:00 PM / Setagaya Municipal Komazawa Junior High School / Every other Thursday & Saturday / 6:00 PM – 9:30 PM / Kiyose City Gymnasium, Uemura Kaga Memorial Sports Center, Wako City General Gymnasium, etc.

活動内容: We at the Anchor Volleyball Club operate under the motto, “Give it your all in both volleyball and fun!” On the volleyball side, we primarily hold practice twice a week on Tuesdays and Thursdays in Nishi-Ogikubo, and we actively participate in various tournaments, including those held in Setagaya. Our members range from beginners to experienced players who have been selected for the prefectural team, and we play on separate courts for men and women.On the social side, we organize many events, including barbecues, beach volleyball, Christmas parties, and trips to Disneyland. During our five annual training camps, in addition to intensive volleyball practice for tournaments, we also engage in seasonal activities such as swimming in the summer and skiing or snowboarding in the winter. In the evenings, we hold recreational activities to foster camaraderie among club members. If you want to enjoy your college life to the fullest, join Anchor!
活動日時・場所: Every Tuesday and Thursday / 6:30 PM – 9:00 PM / Ogikubo Junior High School

活動内容: Hello everyone, this is the Waseda M+ Volleyball Club. We hold volleyball practice every Tuesday and Thursday, primarily at the Tokorozawa Campus. One of our main attractions is that everyone can enjoy participating in the club regardless of year level, so whether you’re an experienced player or a beginner who’s recently developed an interest in volleyball, please feel free to drop by. In addition to playing volleyball, we host a variety of seasonal events throughout the year, including cherry blossom viewing, barbecues, and winter sports.We also actively welcome international students, so if you’re interested in experiencing different languages and cultures, you’ll be able to do so while staying active. Starting college life, you might want to try something new but often find it hard to take the first step. If that sounds like you, please join our club and interact with our senior members, who have a wide range of interests. A whole new kind of life is waiting for you. All of us are looking forward to welcoming new members!
活動日時・場所: Every Tuesday / 4:30 PM – 8:00 PM / Tokorozawa Campus Sports Hall / Every Thursday / 5:30 PM – 7:30 PM / Gymnasium in Tokorozawa City

活動内容:
We meet every Monday and Thursday at the driving range near Nishi-Ogikubo Station! Sessions are held in two time slots: 5:00 PM–7:00 PM and 7:00 PM–9:00 PM, so you can come whenever you like! Participation is open to everyone.
/
/
/
/We also hold a monthly event where we go to a golf course to play. Depending on your results, you might even win some great prizes!
/
/
/
/We hold training camps three times a year. We go once during summer break and once during winter break, and in February, we go on an overnight trip for skiing and snowboarding!!
/
/
/
/Also, since our club belongs to the East Japan Student Golf Association (HGA), we can interact with golf clubs from other universities. The HGA holds league tournaments in the spring and fall, and Padi won the championship last year!!
/
/
/
/Through the HGA, you can also participate in part-time jobs assisting at professional tournaments (short-term, overnight positions).
/
/
/
/You’ll get to see the professionals’ powerful play up close, making it a truly valuable experience. If you join Paddy, please be sure to participate!!
/
/
/
/In addition to golf, we hold events such as summer cruise parties, Christmas parties, year-end parties, and New Year’s parties.
/
/
/
/Both beginners and experienced players are very welcome! More than half of our members are beginners, so please feel free to come practice with us!
/
/
/
/Join Paddy and make the best memories of your life!!
活動日時・場所: Every Monday & Thursday / 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM / Nishiogi Golf Center

活動内容:
Most of our members started playing golf in college! We usually meet on Wednesdays from 4:00 PM at the Shinjuku Isetan Men’s Building and on Fridays from 5:00 PM at Metro Green Toyocho!
/
/
/
/Bogey’s strength lies in our relatively small size, which allows you to get to know every member across all grade levels! In addition to twice-weekly practice sessions and monthly rounds, we also organize various events!We hold training camps three times a year: in May during the new student orientation period, and in August and September! Participation in all activities is optional, so you can keep up with the club at your own pace! Club members also often go out for rounds on their own, allowing you to enjoy a fulfilling college life!
/
/
/
/Membership is open to students of all years, and you can join at any time!
/
/
/
/Please come check us out and consider joining!
活動日時・場所: Every Wednesday at 4:00 PM at Shinjuku Isetan Men’s Building / Every Friday at 5:00 PM at Metro Green Toyocho

活動内容:
The Waseda Bowling Club (WBC) is a university-recognized bowling club with a history spanning over 60 years.
/
/We are also part of the Intercollegiate Bowling League, so we interact frequently with students from other universities!
/
/We are affiliated with the Kanto Student Bowling Federation—an organization run entirely by students—as representatives of Waseda University,
/
/and our members participate in various tournaments, including team and individual competitions.
/
/In the 2016 academic year, we entered our sixth "golden age," achieving outstanding results: we won the 5-player team event at the Summer Kanto Student Bowling Championships, won the 5-player team event at the Fall Regular League, and placed second in the All-Japan University 5-player team event.
/
/That said, there are no specific qualifications or experience required to join the club!
/
/Most of us are beginners who started bowling in college, so lack of experience is absolutely no problem—in fact, we welcome it!!
/
/In addition to practicing about twice a week, we actively interact with students from other universities by holding joint practices with students from Keio, the University of Tokyo, Komazawa, Senshu, and Dokkyo Universities,
/
/and by forming teams together to compete in tournaments.
/
/No matter how bad you are at first, or even if you have no athletic ability, you can improve at bowling.
/
/Our upperclassmen will support you with anything you don’t understand, from bowling equipment to choosing your own ball!
/
/Why not try curving the ball and scoring over 200?
/
/We at the Waseda Bowling Club look forward to hearing from you not just during orientation season, but all year round!
活動日時・場所: Generally every Monday and Thursday, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM. Location: (until March 2023) Nakano Sunplaza Bowl; (from April 2023) Takadanobaba Grand Bowl

The Waseda Polar Bears practice daily with the goal of winning the league championships and the final tournament, which are held twice a year in the spring and fall.
/
/
/
/Experienced players are welcome, of course, but beginners are also very welcome! (Experienced players will provide one-on-one coaching at the beginning!) We take our twice-weekly practices seriously, but the atmosphere is very friendly and welcoming once practice is over. We are recruiting both players and managers. We regularly update our social media accounts, such as Instagram and Twitter, with not only match results but also daily posts, so please check them out!
/
/
/
/Let’s create the best memories of your college life together!
活動日時・場所: Every Thursday / 9:00 PM – 11:30 PM / Mitsui Fudosan Ice Park Funabashi

活動内容: WTTS is in its 58th year and is Waseda University’s only officially recognized table tennis club! We welcome everyone—from beginners to those with experience in the National High School Championships! We practice about two or three times a week, organizing fun events to make practice enjoyable, and we play table tennis in a relaxed yet sometimes serious atmosphere!Plus, we have a dedicated staff member to support beginners, so don’t worry! We also have plenty of opportunities to compete, including participating in open tournaments held in various regions, the “Capital University Tournament” where clubs from universities across the Tokyo metropolitan area gather to play, and “Internal Tournaments” to determine the strongest player in our club! Furthermore, WTTS is officially recognized and partnered with Japan Women’s University, so women and students from other universities are welcome to join with confidence—we’d love to have you! It’s also a great chance for Waseda students to make friends with students from other universities!You’ll meet all kinds of people! We’re also serious about our events. During the April recruitment period, we host fun events like cherry blossom viewing, BBQs, and a Yokohama tour exploring Minato Mirai. Plus, with ski trips and week-long training camps in spring and summer, you’re sure to make plenty of great memories beyond just table tennis! Joining WTTS is guaranteed to make your college life fulfilling! We accept new members anytime. Please feel free to stop by!
活動日時・場所: Every Thursday, Tuesday, or Friday / Starting around 3:00 PM or 6:00 PM / Student Union Building Room E408 / Shinjuku Cosmic Sports Center, etc.

活動内容:
Sports Lovers was founded in 1972 and is a long-standing club now in its 42nd generation of executive members.
/
/Every Tuesday and Friday, we play basketball and volleyball at a gym near Waseda University.
/
/The schedule may vary, but we generally meet for two hours from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM, splitting the time equally between basketball and volleyball.
/
/While we have some experienced players, there are also many beginners, so we follow the "Sports Lovers Rule" that "having fun is the top priority." We keep things relaxed and enjoyable, just like high school PE class. We have so much fun together that there’s always laughter during our sessions!
/
/The gender ratio is roughly 50/50, and since we’re an intercollegiate club, students from other universities are, of course, more than welcome.
/
/Why not join Sports Lovers and play basketball and volleyball with us? We’re looking forward to seeing you!
活動日時・場所: Every Tuesday & Friday / 5:00 PM / Toyama Sunrise

活動内容: Munich is a fun club where handball enthusiasts gather! No distinction between men and women, or between upperclassmen and underclassmen! We welcome participants from other universities and vocational schools, and our selling point is a cozy, welcoming atmosphere where everyone can enjoy themselves. In the spring and fall league tournaments, we consistently achieve strong results by winning matches against other universities. We don’t have a fixed starting lineup—everyone plays, and everyone has contributed to our victories. That’s what we’re proud of at Munich!Beginners and those returning to the sport after a break are more than welcome! During university breaks, we have summer training camps, summer trips organized by second- and third-year students, snowboarding camps, and spring training camps—we take our events seriously and have a blast! We practice once a week, which is just the right amount, and on other days, we often go out for meals or hang out together—we’re a very close-knit group! We’re recruiting new members year-round, not just during orientation week. If you’re interested in playing handball, come check us out at Higashifushimi!
活動日時・場所: Every Monday / 6:00 PM – 9:00 PM / Higashifushimi Sports Hall

活動内容: We hold monthly sessions for five sports: baseball, basketball, soccer, tennis, and volleyball. We are the largest multi-sport club at Waseda University. We have a friendly, family-like atmosphere and enjoy a relaxed mood during our activities. In addition, we have plenty of events, including seven training camps per year. As a large club, our large-scale training camps are always a huge success.Furthermore, our baseball team competes annually in the Waseda League and the Unified Tournament, while our volleyball and basketball teams collaborate with two other clubs each year to host the “Waseda Ball Cup,” where we showcase the results of our daily training. Since our activities are relaxed, anyone—whether you just want to get some light exercise or aren’t particularly athletic—can enjoy them. Additionally, as a long-standing club with a 37-year history, we hold an alumni gathering every year, providing an opportunity to consult with senior members who are now working professionals about career paths.
活動日時・場所: Irregular

活動内容: The Waseda University Squash Club, commonly known as "Waseda Squash," is the only squash club at Waseda University. Since most people start playing squash in college, the majority of our members are beginners. All club members are Waseda students, and of course, you’re welcome to join multiple clubs! Practices are held on a drop-in basis, so you can participate whenever you like at your own pace—please feel free to come join us!In addition to regular practice, Waseda Squash Club hosts various events such as barbecues and Christmas parties. The highlight, without a doubt, is our summer training camp held in September. Since the ocean is right in front of our lodging, we enjoy the summer together while practicing squash! Furthermore, Waseda Squash Club boasts many players who have competed in national tournaments and achieved impressive results. Whether you want to seriously dedicate yourself to squash or just enjoy events with everyone, that’s what Waseda University Squash Club is all about!
活動日時・場所: Every Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday / 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM / Akabane, Shirokanedai, Asagaya

活動内容:
The Wyverns Cricket Club is Waseda University’s only cricket club! Both our men’s and women’s teams have won the All-Japan Student Championships. While we take the sport seriously, our motto is “Let’s enjoy every day.” We currently have 71 members, and we warmly welcome both experienced players and beginners who want to start a new sport in college.
We practice three times a week (Wednesdays, Fridays, and Sundays), but attendance is not mandatory. Since you can participate at your own pace, it’s easy to balance the club with your studies and part-time jobs. We pride ourselves on our close-knit community, which transcends year levels and gender. Even on days without practice, we enjoy lunch together, and we have plenty of events beyond cricket, such as training camps, trips to Disney, and darts outings.
We also have international students on our team, making natural cultural exchange a unique charm of our club. There are plenty of opportunities to interact with teams from other universities and adult leagues as well. If you’re interested, please come check out a practice or event! We post the latest updates on social media (Instagram, etc.). All our players and managers are looking forward to welcoming new members!
活動日時・場所: Wednesdays / 1:30 PM / Takadanobaba  Fridays / Varies / Waseda  Sundays / 1:00 PM / Kita-Senju

活動内容: An officially recognized university club! We’re an all-Waseda group where everyone from beginners to experienced players enjoys practicing together.We also have plenty of events outside of badminton, such as welcome parties in the spring and BBQs in the summer! We also hold training camps twice a year! Over 100 people participate in the annual training camp, spending a fulfilling week together. And get this! We even have our own club room in the Student Union Building! Our main practice locations are the Koto Ward Sports Hall, Akabane Gymnasium, Toda City Sports Center, and Wako City General Gymnasium. Major annual events include: April: Welcome Party After-Party; May:Welcome Recreation Event, Waseda-Keio Baseball Game, June: Singles Tournament, August: Mixed Doubles Tournament, Summer Training Camp, September: Team Matches, October: Final Party for the Executive Committee, November: Doubles Tournament, December: Mixed Doubles Tournament, February: Spring Training Camp, Farewell Match, March: Final Responsibilities (No activities in January or July due to exam periods).There are still tons of things I can’t possibly list here! Of course, we also have matches against other clubs! Because we’re a large group, there are plenty of opportunities to meet new people. Please come to practice sometime!
活動日時・場所: 1–2 times a week / Koto Ward Sports Hall, Akabane Gymnasium, Toda City Sports Center, Wako City General Gymnasium, etc.

活動内容: The Badminton Club J-Birds is the only badminton club at Waseda University’s Tokorozawa Campus! We have members of all skill levels, from beginners to experts, and we practice together regardless of ability! We train daily in preparation for the Waseda University internal tournament held twice a year (commonly known as the “Da-Cup”), tournaments organized by the Kanto Badminton Club Federation (UBF), and other regional tournaments.In addition to practice, we host a variety of events, including the “J-Cup,” an internal friendly tournament, three annual training camps, and other member-organized events. We’re a free-spirited and welcoming club that offers both intense and laid-back activities, so everyone is sure to have a great time!
活動日時・場所: Every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday / 4:00 PM / Tokorozawa Campus Sports Hall

活動内容: Choco Let's is an all-Waseda badminton club with no drinking, and a 1:1 ratio of both men to women and beginners to experienced players. We have many beginners, and our experienced members are happy to teach you, so if you’ve never played before but have even a little interest in badminton, please come join our orientation practice! Our regular practices consist of doubles matches, and unlike traditional clubs, there is absolutely no running or mandatory attendance!Our philosophy is “come when you want and play badminton,” so even if you’re busy with your major or other clubs, you can easily balance it all! Plus, since our regular practices are held near the university (mainly near the Science and Engineering Campus), you won’t have to worry about transportation costs or time spent getting to the venue! In addition to badminton, we also host events like Christmas parties and sports days, so if you’re interested, please check out our website!!
活動日時・場所: About twice a week on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Fridays, or Sundays / From late afternoon into the evening / Gyms near Takadanobaba

活動内容: As a member of the Kanto Student Joint Group, Waseda Ren participates in Awa Odori festivals held in Tokushima and Koenji alongside Keio University, Sophia University, Chuo University, Tokyo University of Science, Meiji University, Toyo University, and Yokohama National University.Our members include students from all over Japan, not just those from Tokushima. 活動内容:
W.U.B. is Waseda’s oldest street dance club, celebrating its 41st anniversary this year. We usually practice by genre in studios or the Student Union Building. Unlike other clubs, we don’t mix genres, so you can master the style you love. We also offer lessons from professional dancers, allowing both beginners and experienced members to improve their skills.W.U.B. holds regular practice sessions—not just before events—so you can work on basics and other routine drills alongside your peers. We focus on both battles and showcases, and our ability to perform in a wide range of settings is one of our strengths.
In addition to the Waseda Festival, we hold our own solo performances and showcase events at clubs, and we also participate in external events, so you can dance as much as you like. We are also members of the Six Universities Street Dance Federation and compete in tournaments such as the Waseda-Keio Battle and All Japan.

February: Winter Night
March: All-Japan Championship
Irregular: Club Battle Events (once every 3–4 months)

Lessons cover the basics and include choreography, so both beginners and experienced dancers can enjoy the group.We perform at various events like the Waseda Festival and Winter Live with great enthusiasm! The costumes we wear for performances are glamorous, vibrant, and adorable—you’ll definitely want to try them on the moment you see them!! We also interact with students from other universities through the Flamenco Student Federation, so you’ll have the chance to make friends from all over! We’re currently recruiting not only dancers but also backup singers and guitarists!

Brilliant Pinks, commonly known as "Bripin," is the only all-female dance club at Waseda University!
/
/
/
/We practice daily in preparation for our solo performances in June and December, as well as for the Waseda Festival. We primarily focus on four genres—girls, hip, lock, and punking—and you can choose which style to perform for each stage. We’re looking forward to welcoming new students who are motivated and passionate about dance! Beginners are also very welcome! Let’s make your college life fulfilling together!

名前: 早稲田大学ジャズダンスサークルOasis
活動内容: Thank you for visiting our page! Oasis is Jazz Dance Circle officially approved by Waseda University. To begin with, jazz dance in modern years is defined as dance that consists of diverse genres of dance and music with the sensibility of absolute freedom. Therefore, you will be able to choose what you dance from a variety of genres in Oasis: hip hop, street dance, R&B, ballet, contemporary dance as well as jazz. Our members also have diversity in their backgrounds; they may come from other universities, and in addition, some have rich experiences of dance in the past, and other had never danced before Oasis. Despite the fact, it is true that we perform on the same stage together, because we all practice very hard. Our coach supervises our regular practices two days a week, on Mondays and Thursdays at studios near Waseda, and there are more additional practices especially when we have forthcoming performances. Our major activities are listed below: live for freshmen (‘Shinkan Live’: April), performance in Waseda Student Culture and Arts Festival (June), Summer Live (August), performance in Waseda Festival (November), and a jazz dance contest (November). If you need more information and want to watch our dance videos, please visit our website and follow our SNS (Twitter, Instagram and YouTube) accounts shown below! We are recruiting both men and women in first or second year who enroll any universities. We look forward to seeing you all at our performances!

活動内容: Waseda! Waseda! We’re so happy!! Let’s go back to 2002. In an era when Yosakoi had not yet become widespread among students, one man stood up: our founder, Mr. Yoshida. He was deeply moved the first time he saw Yosakoi. Driven by that passion, he founded his own team—Odori Samurai. Now in its 15th generation, the tradition continues to be passed down.We are a student Yosakoi team that travels all over Japan—from Hokkaido in the north to Kochi in the south—dancing our hearts out. We work every day with the goal of bringing energy, inspiration, and a sense of wonder to our audience.This year’s performance is titled “ROCK YOU.” We aim to draw the audience into the world created by Odori Samurai, to shake their hearts and the world itself. We will express our quest for our own radiance through everything we have—from choreography and music to costumes, the dancers’ voices, and our passion.

名前: Waseda University Hawaiian Folk Dance Society
活動内容:
Aloha~!
